notes.title: Hope's Farm 2 - Update 0.133- Freshly Harvested Improvements!
notes.content:
[b]Howdy Farmers![/b]

Thanks a bushel for your [b]amazing feedback[/b] and for helping us keep Hope's Farm running smoothly with your bug reports and suggestions!

[b]What's New on the Farm:[/b]
[list]
[*] We've plowed over those language barriers! Now, our international farmers can easily select their preferred language in the Options menu – happy farming to everyone! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438536/27a230764a6dbe97353af7b0a6eabbbb06542b72.png[/img]
[*] Other bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]
Thanks for being such a fantastic community! Keep on planting, matching, and having a barn-load of fun in Hope's Farm 2!

Don't wait! Version 0.133[b] is available now[/b] – let the farming fun continue!

notes.title: 🌾🚜 Hope's Farm 2 Launches on Steam Today with a 20% Discount! 🎉🐔
notes.content:
Fans of farming and puzzle games, rejoice! 🌱✨ Hope's Farm 2 is officially launching on Steam today! 🎮 This highly anticipated sequel brings even more engaging gameplay, new challenges, and exciting mechanics that will keep players entertained for hours. 🌻🚜

In Hope's Farm 2, players will dive into a vibrant world of farming and Match-3 puzzles, growing crops 🌽🥕, taking care of adorable farm animals 🐮🐔, and completing various quests to restore the farm to its former glory. With stunning visuals, relaxing gameplay, and a charming story, this game is perfect for players of all ages. 🌟

To celebrate the launch, Hope's Farm 2 is available with a special introductory 20% discount 🏷️ for a limited time. Don’t miss the chance to start your farming adventure at a discounted price! 🎊

Head over to Steam now and start building the farm of your dreams! 🌿🚜🐑

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3416370/Hopes_Farm_2/

notes.title: 🚜 Hope’s Farm 2 is LIVE on Steam Next Fest! 🌾
notes.content:
Hey, farmers! 🐮✨

We’ve got some amazing news—Hope’s Farm 2 is officially part of Steam Next Fest! 🎉 That means you can jump into the farm life right now with our free demo!

We’ve been working hard to make this the coziest, most fun farm-and-puzzle adventure out there, and we couldn’t have done it without your support! Whether you love tending to crops, taking care of fluffy alpacas, or solving puzzles to fulfill orders, there’s something here for you.

Your support means the world! 💚 By playing the demo and Wishlisting the game, you're helping us bring Hope’s Farm 2 to life in the best way possible! So, grab your boots, test out the game, and let us know what you think!

Thanks for being part of this journey—now, let’s get farming! 🚜🐷🐝
